name: Clio
summary: Law practice management software with an AI assistant.
description: Clio handles matters, time tracking, billing, documents and client intake for law firms. Its AI assistant summarizes documents, drafts text and finds information within a matter.
features: AI assistant to summarize and draft

howToUse.title: Sign up on Clio
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Gestion des dossiers et du temps passé
Assistant IA pour résumer et rédiger
summary_fr: Logiciel de gestion de cabinet d'avocats avec assistant IA.
description_fr: Clio gère les dossiers, le temps passé, la facturation, les documents et la relation client des cabinets d'avocats. Son assistant IA résume des documents, rédige des brouillons et retrouve les informations d'un dossier.
